name: Farewell, Bunny Boy
source:
A short story about a cute bunny town, and a cute bunny boy leaving behind his calm life and loved ones for something much more.
In the future, more chapters in the story will become available, made in March 2015 for NaNoReNo 2015!

[From:[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=50&t=31454] Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
一个关于可爱的兔子小镇的短篇故事，一个可爱的兔子男孩为了更多的事情而离开了平静的生活和亲人。
未来，我们将推出更多故事章节，这些章节是2015年3月为《NaNoReNo 2015》制作的！

[来自：[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=50&t=31454] Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
